kit.name: Octobolt Flash
kit.description: Gains 1 point(s) of Slashed Dream. Inflicts 1 stack(s) of Crimson Knot on a single target enemy, dealing Lightning DMG equal to {lightning_dmg} of Acheron's ATK to this target, as well as Lightning DMG equal to {2} of Acheron's ATK to adjacent targets.

kit.name: Slashed Dream Cries in Red
kit.description:
Sequentially unleash Rainblade 3 times and Stygian Resurge 1 time, dealing Lightning DMG up to {lightning_dmg} of Acheron's ATK to a single target enemy, as well as Lightning DMG up to {2} of Acheron's ATK to other targets.

Rainblade: Deals Lightning DMG equal to {3} of Acheron's ATK to a single target enemy and removes up to 3 stacks of Crimson Knot from the target. When Crimson Knot is removed, immediately deals Lightning DMG equal to {4} of Acheron's ATK to all enemies. For every stack of Crimson Knot removed, this DMG Multiplier is additionally increased, up to a maximum of {dmg_multiplier}.

Stygian Resurge: Deals Lightning DMG equal to {6} of Acheron's ATK to all enemies and remove all Crimson Knots.

Crimson Knot cannot be applied to enemies during the Ultimate.

kit.name: Atop Rainleaf Hangs Oneness
kit.description:
When Slashed Dream reaches 9 point(s), the Ultimate can be activated. During the Ultimate, reduces enemies' Toughness regardless of Weakness Types and reduces all enemies' All-Type RES by {enemies_all_type_res}, lasting until the end of the Ultimate.
When any unit inflicts debuffs on an enemy target while using their ability, Acheron gains 1 point of Slashed Dream and inflicts 1 stack of Crimson Knot on a target. If debuffs are inflicted on multiple targets, then the 1 stack of Crimson Knot will be inflicted on the enemy target with the most Crimson Knot stacks. This effect can only trigger once for every ability use.
After an enemy target exits the field or gets defeated by any unit while Acheron is on the field, their Crimson Knot stacks will be transferred to the enemy target with the most Crimson Knot stacks on the whole field.

kit.name: Quadrivalent Ascendance
kit.description:
Immediately attacks the enemy. At the start of each wave, gains Quadrivalent Ascendance, dealing Lightning DMG equal to 200% of Acheron's ATK to all enemies and reducing Toughness of all enemies irrespective of Weakness Types. When breaking Weaknesses, triggers the Lightning Weakness Break effect.
Quadrivalent Ascendance: After using the Ultimate, Acheron gains 1 point(s) of Slashed Dream and inflicts 1 stack(s) of Crimson Knot on a single random enemy.
If attacking a normal enemy, immediately defeats them without entering combat. When not hitting enemies, no Technique Points are consumed.

kit.name: Red Oni
kit.description: When battle starts, immediately gains 5 point(s) of Slashed Dream and applies 5 stack(s) of Crimson Knot to a random enemy. When Slashed Dream reaches its upper limit, for every point of Slashed Dream that exceeds the limit, gains 1 stack of Quadrivalent Ascendance. Enables Quadrivalent Ascendance to stack up to 3 time(s).

kit.name: The Abyss
kit.description: When there are 1 or 2 Nihility characters other than Acheron in the team, the DMG dealt by Acheron's Basic ATK, Skill, and Ultimate increases to 115% or 160% of the original DMG respectively.

kit.name: Thunder Core
kit.description: When the Ultimate's Rainblade hits enemy targets that have Crimson Knot, the DMG dealt by Acheron increases by 30%, stacking up to 3 time(s) and lasting for 3 turn(s). And when Stygian Resurge triggers, additionally deals DMG for 6 times. Each time deals Lightning DMG equal to 25% of Acheron's ATK to a single random enemy and is considered as Ultimate DMG.

kit.name: Silenced Sky Spake Sooth
kit.description: When dealing DMG to debuffed enemies, increases CRIT Rate by 18%.

kit.name: Mute Thunder in Still Tempest
kit.description: The number of Nihility characters required for the Trace "The Abyss" to achieve its highest possible effect is reduced by 1. When this unit's turn starts, gains 1 point of Slashed Dream and inflicts 1 stack of Crimson Knot on the enemy with the most Crimson Knot stacks.

kit.description:

Also, respectively deals Lightning DMG equal to {2} of Aglaea's ATK and {2} of Garmentmaker's ATK to adjacent targets.
"Slash by a Thousandfold Kiss" cannot recover Skill Points.

kit.name: Rise, Exalted Renown
kit.description: Restores HP to Garmentmaker by {hp_to_garmentmaker} of its Max HP. If Garmentmaker is absent, then summons the memosprite Garmentmaker and makes this unit immediately take action.

kit.name: Dance, Destined Weaveress
kit.description:
Summons the memosprite Garmentmaker. If Garmentmaker is already on the field, then restores its HP to max. Aglaea enters the "Supreme Stance" state and immediately takes action.
While in "Supreme Stance," Aglaea gains the SPD Boost stacks from Garmentmaker's Memosprite Talent, with each stack increasing this unit's SPD by {spd}. Enhances Basic ATK to "Slash by a Thousandfold Kiss," and cannot use Skill. Garmentmaker is immune to Crowd Control debuffs.
A countdown appears on the Action Order, with its own SPD set at 100. While the countdown exists, using Ultimate again will reset the countdown. When the countdown's turn starts, Garmentmaker self-destructs. When Garmentmaker disappears, Aglaea dispels the "Supreme Stance" state.

kit.name: Rosy-Fingered
kit.description: The memosprite Garmentmaker has an initial SPD equal to 35% of Aglaea's SPD and a Max HP equal to {max_hp} of Aglaea's Max HP plus {2} While Garmentmaker is on the field, Aglaea's attacks inflict the target with the "Seam Stitch" state. After attacking enemies in the "Seam Stitch" state, further deals Lightning Additional DMG equal to {lightning_additional_dmg} of Aglaea's ATK. "Seam Stitch" only takes effect on the most recently inflicted target.

kit.name: Meteoric Sunder
kit.description: Summons the memosprite Garmentmaker and launches a forward joint attack. After entering battle, regenerates 30 Energy and deals Lightning DMG equal to 100% of Aglaea's ATK to all enemy targets. Then, randomly inflicts the "Seam Stitch" state on a random enemy target.

kit.name: Thorned Snare
kit.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to {lightning_dmg} of ATK to one enemy and Lightning DMG equal to {2} of ATK to adjacent targets.

kit.name: A Body Brewed by Tears
kit.description: After attacking an enemy afflicted with "Seam Stitch," increases this unit's SPD by {spd}, stacking up to 6 time(s). When Garmentmaker takes action, automatically uses "Thorned Snare," prioritizing enemies under the "Seam Stitch" state.

kit.name: Bloom of Drying Grass
kit.description: When Garmentmaker disappears, regenerates 20 Energy for Aglaea.

kit.name: The Speeding Summer
kit.description: When Garmentmaker is summoned, this unit's action advances by 100%.

kit.name: Last Thread of Fate
kit.description: When Garmentmaker disappears, up to 1 stack(s) of the SPD Boost from the Memosprite Talent can be retained. When Garmentmaker is summoned again, gains the corresponding number of SPD Boost stacks.

kit.name: The Myopic's Doom
kit.description: While in "Supreme Stance," increases Aglaea's and Garmentmaker's ATK by an amount equal to 720% of Aglaea's SPD plus 360% of Garmentmaker's SPD.

kit.name: The Speeding Sol
kit.description: At the start of battle, if this unit's Energy is lower than 50%, regenerates this unit's Energy to 50%.

kit.name: Drift at the Whim of Venus
kit.description: The enemy afflicted with "Seam Stitch" takes 15% increased DMG. After Aglaea or Garmentmaker attacks this target, additionally regenerates 20 Energy.

kit.name: Sail on the Raft of Eyelids
kit.description: When Aglaea or Garmentmaker takes action, enables the DMG dealt by Aglaea and Garmentmaker to ignore 14% of the target's DEF. This effect stacks up to 3 time(s) and lasts until any unit, other than Aglaea or Garmentmaker, actively uses an ability.

kit.name: Bequeath in the Coalescence of Dew
kit.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Memosprite Talent Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

kit.name: Flicker Below the Surface of Marble
kit.description: The SPD Boost effect from the Memosprite Talent has its max stack limit increased by 1. After Aglaea uses an attack, can also make Garmentmaker gain the SPD Boost effect from the Memosprite Talent.

kit.name: Weave Under the Shroud of Woe
kit.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Memosprite Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

kit.description: While Aglaea is in "Supreme Stance," increases her and Garmentmaker's Lightning RES PEN by 20%. When Aglaea's or Garmentmaker's SPD is greater than 160/240/320, the Joint ATK DMG dealt by them increases by 10%/30%/60%.

kit.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to {wind_dmg} of Anaxa's ATK to one designated enemy.

kit.name: Fractal, Exiles Fallacy
kit.description:
Deals Wind DMG equal to {wind_dmg} of Anaxa's ATK to one designated enemy and additionally deals 4 instance(s) of DMG. Each instance of DMG deals Wind DMG equal to {wind_dmg} of Anaxa's ATK to one random enemy, prioritizing Bouncing to enemy targets that have not been hit by this instance of Skill.
When used, for each attackable enemy on the field, this Skill has its DMG dealt increased by 20%.

kit.name: Sprouting Life Sculpts Earth
kit.description:
Inflicts the "Sublimation" state on all enemies, then deals Wind DMG equal to {wind_dmg} of Anaxa's ATK to all enemies.
In the "Sublimation" state, the targets will be simultaneously inflicted with Physical, Fire, Ice, Lightning, Wind, Quantum, and Imaginary Weaknesses, lasting until the start of the targets' turn. If the targets do not have Control RES, they are unable to take action in the "Sublimation" state.

kit.name: Tetrad Wisdom Reigns Thrice
kit.description:
Each time Anaxa lands 1 hit on enemy targets, inflicts 1 Weakness of a random Type to the targets, lasting for 3 turn(s), with priority to the Weakness Type that the target doesn't already possess.
While Anaxa is on the field, inflicts the "Qualitative Disclosure" state on enemy targets that have at least 5 different Types of Weaknesses. Anaxa deals {dmg} increased DMG to targets afflicted with the "Qualitative Disclosure" state. In addition, after using Basic ATK or Skill on them, unleashes 1 additional instance of Skill on the targets. This additional Skill does not consume any Skill Points and cannot trigger this effect again. If the target has been defeated before the additional Skill is used, it will be cast on one random enemy instead.

kit.name: Prism of the Pupil
kit.description: After using Technique, inflicts the Terrified state on enemies in a set area. Terrified enemies will flee in a direction away from Anaxa for 10 second(s). When allies enter battle via actively attacking a Terrified enemy, it will always be considered as entering battle via attacking a Weakness. After entering battle, Anaxa applies 1 Weakness of the attacker's Type to every enemy target, lasting for 3 turn(s).

kit.name: Imperative Hiatus
kit.description:
Based on the number of "Erudition" characters in the team, one of the following effects will be triggered in the current battle:
1 character: Increases Anaxa's CRIT DMG by 140%.
At least 2 characters: Increases DMG dealt by all allies by 50%.

kit.name: Qualitative Shift
kit.description: For every 1 different Weakness Type an enemy target has, the DMG that Anaxa deals to that target ignores 4% of their DEF. Up to a max of 7 Weakness Types can be taken into account for this effect.

kit.name: Roaming Signifier
kit.description:
When using Basic ATK, additionally regenerates 10 Energy.
At the start of the turn, if there are no enemy targets in the "Qualitative Disclosure" state, immediately regenerates 30 Energy.

kit.name: Magician, Isolated by Stars

kit.name: Kanshou and Bakuya

kit.name: Caladbolg II: Fake Spiral Sword

After actively using his Skill 5 time(s) or when there are insufficient Skill Points, using his Skill again causes him to exit the "Circuit Connection" state. kit.name: End

If the target is defeated before this Follow-up ATK is launched, the Follow-up ATK will be directed at one random enemy instead.

kit.name: Clairvoyance

kit.name: The Unreached Dream

kit.description: Consumes 180 Energy and deals Physical DMG equal to {physical_dmg} of Argenti's ATK to all enemies. And further deals DMG for 6 extra time(s), with each time dealing Physical DMG equal to {2} of Argenti's ATK to a random enemy.

kit.description: For every enemy hit when Argenti uses his Basic Attack, Skill, or Ultimate, regenerates Argenti's Energy by 3, and grants him a stack of Apotheosis, increasing his CRIT Rate by {crit_rate}. This effect can stack up to 10 time(s).

kit.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to {lightning_dmg} of Arlan's ATK to a single enemy and Lightning DMG equal to {2} of Arlan's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.

Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

kit.description: When struck by a killing blow after entering battle, instead of becoming knocked down, Arlan immediately restores his HP to 25% of his Max HP. This effect is automatically removed after it is triggered once or after 2 turn(s) have elapsed.

kit.name: Hammer and Tongs
kit.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

kit.name: Self-Sacrifice
kit.description: When the current HP percentage drops to 50% or below, Ultimate deals 20% more DMG, and the DMG multiplier for adjacent targets is raised to the same level as that for the primary target.

kit.name: Talons: Inculcate Decorum
kit.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to {lightning_dmg} of Ashveil's ATK to one designated enemy.

kit.name: Flog: Smite Evil
kit.description:
Makes one designated enemy become the "Bait," dealing it Lightning DMG equal to {it_lightning_dmg} of Ashveil's ATK. If the target is already the "Bait," additionally deals it Lightning DMG equal to {2} of Ashveil's ATK, and recovers 1 Skill Point(s). When the "Bait" exists on the field, all enemies' DEF gets reduced by {def_gets_reduced}.
When there is no "Bait" on the field, Ashveil immediately makes the enemy target with the lowest HP on the field become the "Bait." The "Bait" state only takes effect on the most recently applied target.

kit.name: Banquet: Insatiable Appetite
kit.description:
Makes one designated enemy become the "Bait," dealing it Lightning DMG equal to {it_lightning_dmg} of Ashveil's ATK. Then, immediately launches 1 instance of enhanced Talent's Follow-Up ATK against the "Bait." And Ashveil gains 3 Charge.
This enhanced Talent's Follow-Up ATK does not consume Charge. Whenever "Gluttony" reaches 4 stack(s) or more, consumes 4 stack(s) of "Gluttony" to additionally deal 1 instance of Lightning DMG equal to {lightning_dmg} of Ashveil's ATK. And when this instance of Follow-Up ATK deals a killing blow to the target, it will continue to deal DMG to a new "Bait." This triggers until "Gluttony" becomes lower than 4 stack(s). If all enemy targets currently on the field have been dealt killing blows, the enhanced Talent's Follow-Up ATK will immediately end.

kit.description: Ashveil has an initial Charge of 2 and can hold up to a max of 3. After the "Bait" gets attacked by other ally targets, Ashveil regenerates a fixed amount of 8 Energy, then consumes 1 Charge to launch Follow-Up ATK against the "Bait," dealing Lightning DMG equal to {lightning_dmg} of Ashveil's ATK. Afterwards, gains 2 stack(s) of "Gluttony," which can stack up to 12.

After using Technique, inflicts Daze on enemies within a set area for 10 second(s). Dazed enemies will not actively attack ally targets.
When entering combat via actively attacking a Dazed enemy, deals Lightning DMG to all enemies equal to 100% of Ashveil's ATK, and grants Ashveil 1 Charge.

kit.name: Damnation Trail

kit.name: First Fang

kit.name: Phantom Limb
kit.description: DMG dealt by Ashveil's Follow-Up ATK increases by 80%. And for every 1 stack(s) of "Gluttony" in possession, DMG dealt by Follow-Up ATK additionally increases by 10%.

kit.name: Beware: Venture Not at Full Moon
kit.description: While Ashveil is on the field, increases DMG taken by all enemies by 24%. When an enemy target's current HP percentage is 50% or lower, the DMG they take increases to 36%.

kit.name: Knock: Where Snickers Echo
kit.description: The max stack limit of "Gluttony" increases to 18. After each time Ashveil launches the enhanced Talent's Follow-Up ATK, refunds 35% of the removed "Gluttony" stacks.

kit.name: Hush: Unsaid Between Friends
kit.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

kit.name: Astral Blessing
kit.description: Increases SPD of all allies by {spd} for 2 turn(s).

kit.name: Astrometry
kit.description:
Gains 1 stack of Charging for every different enemy hit by Asta plus an extra stack if the enemy hit has Fire Weakness.
For every stack of Charging Asta has, all allies' ATK increases by {all_allies_atk}, up to 5 time(s).
Starting from her second turn, Asta's Charging stack count is reduced by 3 at the beginning of every turn.

kit.name: Miracle Flash
kit.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals Fire DMG equal to 50% of Asta's ATK to all enemies.

kit.name: Constellation
kit.description: Asta's DEF increases by 6% for every current Charging stack she possesses.

kit.name: Ignite
kit.description: When Asta is on the field, all allies' Fire DMG increases by 18%.

Asta's Basic ATK has a 80% base chance to Burn the enemy target for 3 turn(s).
Burned enemies take Fire DoT equal to 50% of DMG dealt by Asta's Basic ATK at the start of each turn.

kit.name: Star Sings Sans Verses or Vocals
kit.description: When using Skill, deals DMG for 1 extra time to a random enemy.

kit.name: Moon Speaks in Wax and Wane
kit.description: After using her Ultimate, Asta's Charging stacks will not be reduced in the next turn.

After Arcana causes DMG at the start of each turn, its stacks are not reset. This non-reset effect of Arcana stacks can be triggered up to 1 time(s) for the duration of Epiphany. kit.description:

When there are 3 or more Arcana stacks, deals Wind DoT equal to {wind_dot} of Black Swan's ATK to adjacent targets, with a {target_receives_dot} base chance of inflicting 1 stack of Arcana on adjacent targets.
When there are 7 or more Arcana stacks, enables the current DoT dealt this time to ignore 20% of the target's and adjacent targets' DEF.

The target receives Wind DoT equal to {receives_wind_dot} of Black Swan's ATK at the start of each turn, after which the number of stacks is halved. Each stack of "Arcana" increases this DMG multiplier by {dmg_multiplier}. "Arcana" can stack 50 times, and can continue to stack beyond this limit, with the excess stacks removed after dealing DMG.
DMG from "Arcana" ignores 20% of the target's DEF. Only when "Arcana" deals DMG at the start of the enemy target's turn, adjacent targets take 1 additional instance of Wind DoT equal to {wind_dot} of Black Swan's ATK.

When "Newbud" reaches its maximum limit, can activate the Ultimate. When allies lose HP, Castorice's and Netherwing's DMG dealt increases by {dmg}. This effect can stack up to 3 time(s), lasting for 3 turn(s).
When Netherwing is on the field, "Newbud" cannot be gained through Talent, and every 1 point of HP lost by all allies (except Netherwing) will be converted to an equal amount of HP for Netherwing.

kit.name: Wail, Death's Herald
kit.description:
After using Technique, enters the "Netherveil" state that lasts for 20 seconds. While "Netherveil" is active, enemies are unable to actively approach Castorice.
During "Netherveil," active attacks will cause all enemies within range to enter combat. At the same time, summons the memosprite Netherwing, advances its action by 100%, and deploys the Territory "Lost Netherland." Netherwing has its current HP equal to 50% of max "Newbud." After entering battle, consumes 40% of the current HP of all allies (except Netherwing).
If Netherwing is not summoned after entering battle, Castorice gains "Newbud" by an amount equal to 30% of max "Newbud."

kit.name: Claw Splits the Veil
kit.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to {quantum_dmg} of Castorice's Max HP to all enemies.

kit.name: Breath Scorches the Shadow
kit.description:
Launching "Breath Scorches the Shadow" will consume 25% of Netherwing's Max HP to deal Quantum DMG equal to {quantum_dmg} of Castorice's Max HP to all enemies.
In one attack, "Breath Scorches the Shadow" can be launched repeatedly, with the DMG multiplier increased progressively to {dmg} / {3}. After reaching {3}, it will not increase further. The DMG Multiplier Boost effect will not decrease before Netherwing disappears.
When Netherwing's current HP is equal to or less than 25% of its Max HP, launching this ability will actively reduce HP down to 1, and then trigger the ability effect equal to that of the Talent "Wings Sweep the Ruins."

kit.name: Mooncocoon Shrouds the Form
kit.description: When Netherwing is on the field, it acts as backup for allies. When allies take DMG or consume HP, their current HP can be reduced down to a minimum of 1, after which Netherwing will consume HP at 500% of the original value until Netherwing disappears.

kit.name: Roar Rumbles the Realm
kit.description: When Netherwing is summoned, increases DMG dealt by all allies by 10%, lasting for 3 turn(s).

kit.name: Wings Sweep the Ruins
kit.description: When Netherwing disappears, deals 6 instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Quantum DMG equal to {quantum_dmg} of Castorice's Max HP to one random enemy. At the same time, restores HP by an amount equal to {time_restores_hp} of Castorice's Max HP plus {max_hp} for all allies.

kit.name: Contained Dark Tide
kit.description: After ally targets (excluding Netherwing) receive healing, converts 100% of the healed amount into "Newbud." If Netherwing is on the field, this is converted to Netherwing's HP instead. Each ally target can accumulate a conversion amount up to 12% of the max "Newbud." After any unit takes action, all units reset their accumulated conversion amount.

kit.name: Inverted Torch
kit.description: When Castorice's current HP is higher than or equal to 50% of her Max HP, her SPD increases by 40%. When Netherwing uses "Breath Scorches the Shadow" and deals fatal damage to all enemies on the field or brings them to a point where their HP cannot be reduced further, Netherwing's SPD increases by 100%, lasting for 1 turn.

kit.name: Sanctuary of Mooncocoon
kit.description: After obtaining Castorice or when Castorice is in the current team, receive the following effect: In battle, when an ally character receives a killing blow, all ally characters that received a killing blow in this action enter the "Mooncocoon" state. Characters in "Mooncocoon" temporarily delay becoming downed and can take actions normally. After the action and before the start of the next turn, if their current HP increases or they gain a Shield, "Mooncocoon" is removed. Otherwise, they will be downed immediately. This effect can only trigger once per battle.

kit.name: Where The West Wind Dwells
kit.description: Each time Netherwing uses "Breath Scorches the Shadow," the DMG dealt increases by 30%. This effect stacks up to 6 time(s) and lasts until the end of this turn.

kit.name: Snowbound Maiden, Memory to Tomb
kit.description: When the enemy target's current HP is 80%/50% of Max HP or lower, the DMG dealt to it by "Boneclaw, Doomdrake's Embrace," "Claw Splits the Veil," "Breath Scorches the Shadow," and "Wings Sweep the Ruins" is 120%/140% of the original DMG respectively.

kit.name: Crown on Wings of Bloom
kit.description: After summoning the memosprite Netherwing, Castorice gains 2 stack(s) of "Ardent Will." "Ardent Will" can stack up to 2 time(s) and can be used to offset the HP cost of Netherwing's Memosprite Skill, "Breath Scorches the Shadow" and advance Castorice's action by 100%. When using the next Enhanced Skill, Castorice gains "Newbud" by an amount equal to 30% of max "Newbud."

kit.name: Pious Pilgrim, Dance in Doom
kit.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Memosprite Talent Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

kit.name: Rest in Songs of Gloom
kit.description: While Castorice is on the field, all allies' Incoming Healing during HP restoration increases by 20%.

kit.name: Pristine Pages, Prophecy as Plume
kit.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Memosprite Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

kit.name: Await for Years to Loom
kit.description: When Castorice or Netherwing deals DMG, increases Quantum RES PEN by 20%. During Netherwing's attacks, can reduce enemy Toughness regardless of Weakness Types. When breaking Weaknesses, triggers the Quantum Weakness Break effect. And the number of Bounces for Netherwing's Talent "Wings Sweep the Ruins" additionally increases by 3.

kit.name: King's Castling
kit.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to {wind_dmg} of Cerydra's ATK to one designated enemy.

kit.name: Pawn's Promotion
kit.description: Grants "Military Merit" to one designated ally character and gives Cerydra 1 points of Charge. Charge is capped at 8 points. When Charge reaches 6 points, automatically upgrades the character's "Military Merit" to "Peerage" and dispels their Crowd Control debuffs. The character with "Peerage" is considered to have "Military Merit" simultaneously. The character with "Peerage" increases the CRIT DMG for their dealt Skill DMG by {skill_dmg}, increases their All-Type RES PEN by {all_type_res_pen}, and triggers Coup de Main when using their Skill on enemy targets. After Coup de Main ends, consumes 6 points of Charge to revert "Peerage" to "Military Merit."

kit.name: Scholar's Mate
kit.description: Gains 2 Charge. Deals Wind DMG equal to {wind_dmg} of Cerydra's ATK to all enemies. If no character on the field has "Military Merit," prioritizes granting "Military Merit" to the first character in the current team.

kit.name: Ave Imperator
kit.description: The character with "Military Merit" increases ATK by an amount equal to {merit_increases_atk} of Cerydra's ATK. When the character uses Basic ATK or Skill, Cerydra gains 1 Charge. During Coup de Main, Cerydra cannot gain Charge. After the character with "Military Merit" uses an attack, Cerydra additionally deals 1 instance of Wind Additional DMG equal to {wind_additional_dmg} of her ATK. This effect can trigger up to 20 time(s). The trigger count resets every time Cerydra uses her Ultimate. "Military Merit" only takes effect on the most recent target. When the target changes, Cerydra's Charge is reset to 0.

kit.name: First-Move Advantage
kit.description: After using Technique, gains "Military Merit." When switching the active character, "Military Merit" transfers to the current active character. At the start of the next battle, automatically uses Skill 1 time on the character with "Military Merit" without consuming any Skill Points.

kit.name: Veni
kit.description: For every 100 of Cerydra's ATK that exceeds 2000, increases her CRIT DMG by 18%, up to a max increase of 360%.

kit.name: Vici
kit.description: When using Skill, increases SPD by 20 for this unit and the teammate with "Military Merit," lasting for 3 turn(s). When the character with "Military Merit" uses Basic ATK or Skill, regenerates 5 Energy for Cerydra.

kit.name: Vidi
kit.description: Increases Cerydra's CRIT Rate by 100%. While Cerydra's Charge is below its maximum, the character with "Military Merit" using their Ultimate grants Cerydra 1 Charge. This effect can trigger once per battle.

kit.name: Seize the Crowns of All
kit.description: The character with "Military Merit" ignores 16% of the targets' DEF when dealing DMG. If "Military Merit" has been upgraded to "Peerage," then the character additionally ignores 20% of the targets' DEF when dealing Skill DMG. When Cerydra uses her Skill, regenerates 2 Energy for the designated ally target.

kit.name: Forge the Dreams of Many
kit.description: The character with "Military Merit" deals 40% increased DMG. While a teammate on the field has "Military Merit," Cerydra's DMG dealt increases by 160%.

kit.name: Torch the Laws of Old
kit.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

kit.name: Remake the Realms of Men
kit.description: Increases Ultimate's DMG multiplier by 240%.

kit.name: Help and Hurt Repaid in Full
kit.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

kit.name: A Journey Set Starward
kit.description: The character with "Military Merit" increases their All-Type RES PEN by 20%, and the multiplier for the Additional DMG triggered via "Military Merit" increases by 300%. While a teammate on the field has "Military Merit," Cerydra's All-Type RES PEN increases by 20%.

kit.name: Oops, a Missed Catch
kit.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to {quantum_dmg} of Cipher's ATK to a single enemy.

kit.name: Hey, Jackpot for the Taking
kit.description: There is a 120% base chance to Weaken one designated enemy and adjacent targets, decreasing their DMG dealt by 10% and increasing Cipher's ATK by 30%, lasting for 2 turn(s). At the same time, deals Quantum DMG equal to {quantum_dmg} of Cipher's ATK to one designated enemy, and Quantum DMG equal to {2} of Cipher's ATK to its adjacent targets.

kit.name: Yours Truly, Kitty Phantom Thief!
kit.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to {quantum_dmg} of Cipher's ATK to one designated enemy. Then, deals True DMG equal to 25% of the currently recorded Talent value to one designated enemy, Quantum DMG equal to {enemy_quantum_dmg} of Cipher's ATK to one designated enemy and its adjacent targets, and True DMG equal to 75% of the current Talent's recorded value. This True DMG is Distributed to all Skill targets.

kit.name: The Hospitable Dolosian
kit.description:
When there are no enemy targets in "Patron" state on the battlefield, Cipher immediately causes one enemy target with the highest Max HP on the battlefield to become the "Patron." When using Skill and Ultimate, the primary target becomes the "Patron." The "Patron" state only takes effect on the latest target.
After the "Patron" is attacked by other ally targets, Cipher immediately launches a Follow-up ATK against the "Patron," dealing Quantum DMG equal to {quantum_dmg} of Cipher's ATK. This effect can be triggered up to 1 time(s) each turn, and it resets at the start of Cipher's turn.
Cipher will record 12% of the non-True DMG ally targets dealt to "Patron," but the Overflow DMG will not be recorded. The recorded value is cleared after using Ultimate.

kit.name: Puss in Boots
kit.description:
Obtains "Zagreus's Blessing" for 15 second(s). During this time, Cipher will be undetectable by enemies and her movement speed increases by 50%. When approaching an enemy in the overworld/Simulated Universe/Divergent Universe, there is a chance of immediately obtaining a random Consumable. You can obtain Consumables up to 50 time(s) in each Earth day.
When entering battle with "Zagreus's Blessing" active, deals Quantum DMG equal to 100% of Cipher's ATK to all enemies. Increases the recorded DMG Cipher obtains from this instance of DMG by 200%.

kit.name: 300 Rogues
kit.description: Cipher will record 8% of the non-True DMG ally targets dealt to the enemy targets aside from the "Patron." Overflow DMG is not recorded.

kit.name: Empyrean Strides
kit.description: When Cipher's SPD is greater or equal to 140/170, increases CRIT Rate by 25%/50%, and recorded value by 50%/100%.

kit.name: Sleight of Sky
kit.description: Increases the CRIT DMG dealt by the Talent's Follow-up ATK by 100%. When Cipher is on the battlefield, DMG received by all enemy targets increases by 40%.

kit.name: Read the Room, Seek the Glee
kit.description: Cipher's recorded DMG is 150% of the original recorded DMG value. When using a Follow-up ATK caused by her Talent, increases Cipher's ATK by 80% for 2 turn(s).

kit.name: In the Fray, Nab On a Spree
kit.description: When Cipher hits an enemy target, there is a 120% base chance of causing them to receive 30% more DMG, lasting 2 turn(s).

kit.name: From Thin Air, Hard to Foresee
kit.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

kit.name: The Jig Is Up, Quick to Flee
kit.description: After "Patron" is attacked by an ally target, Cipher deals Quantum Additional DMG equal to 50% of Cipher's ATK to it.

kit.name: Safe in Numbers, Light as a Bee
kit.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

kit.name: The Thief's Game, Unsung and Free
kit.description: Increases DMG dealt by Follow-up ATKs caused by Cipher's Talent by 350%. Records an additional 16% of non-Overflow DMG dealt by this ATK. After resetting the record upon using her Ultimate, returns 20% of the reset record.

kit.name: I Want to Help
kit.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to {physical_dmg} of Clara's ATK to a single enemy.

kit.name: Svarog Watches Over You
kit.description:
Deals Physical DMG equal to {physical_dmg} of Clara's ATK to all enemies, and additionally deals Physical DMG equal to {2} of Clara's ATK to enemies marked by Svarog with a Mark of Counter.
All Marks of Counter will be removed after this Skill is used.

kit.name: Promise, Not Command
kit.description:
After Clara uses Ultimate, DMG dealt to her is reduced by an extra {uses_ultimate_dmg}, and she has greatly increased chances of being attacked by enemies for 2 turn(s).
In addition, Svarog's Counter is enhanced. When an ally is attacked, Svarog immediately launches a Counter, and its DMG multiplier against the enemy increases by {dmg}. Enemies adjacent to it take 50% of the DMG dealt to the primary target enemy. Enhanced Counter(s) can take effect 2 time(s).

kit.name: Because We're Family
kit.description: Under the protection of Svarog, DMG taken by Clara when hit by enemy attacks is reduced by 10%. Svarog will mark enemies who attack Clara with his Mark of Counter and retaliate with a Counter, dealing Physical DMG equal to {physical_dmg} of Clara's ATK.

kit.name: A Small Price for Victory
kit.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. Upon entering battle, the chance Clara will be attacked by enemies increases for 2 turn(s).

kit.name: Kinship
kit.description: When attacked, this unit has a 35% fixed chance to dispel 1 debuff placed on them.

kit.name: Revenge
kit.description: Increases DMG dealt by Svarog's Counter by 30%.

kit.name: Under Protection
kit.description: Increases the chance to resist Crowd Control debuffs by 35%.

kit.name: A Tall Figure
kit.description: Using Skill will not remove Marks of Counter on the enemy.

kit.name: A Tight Embrace
kit.description: After using the Ultimate, ATK increases by 30% for 2 turn(s).

kit.name: Cold Steel Armor
kit.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

kit.name: Family's Warmth
kit.description: After Clara is hit, the DMG taken by Clara is reduced by 30%. This effect lasts until the start of her next turn.

kit.name: A Small Promise
kit.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

kit.name: Long Company
kit.description: After other allies are attacked, Svarog also has a 50% fixed chance to trigger a Counter on the attacker and mark them with a "Mark of Counter." When using Ultimate, the number of Enhanced Counters increases by 1.

kit.name: Lo, Hope Takes Flight!
kit.description: Gains 1 "Recollection" point(s) and deals Ice DMG equal to {ice_dmg} of Cyrene's Max HP to one designated enemy.

kit.name: To Love and Tomorrow ♪
kit.description:
Gains 3 "Recollection" points and deals Ice DMG equal to {ice_dmg} of Cyrene's Max HP to one designated enemy. Then, deals Ice DMG equal to {2} of Cyrene's Max HP to all enemies.
"To Love and Tomorrow ♪" cannot recover Skill Points.

kit.name: Bloom, Elysium of Beyond
kit.description: Gains 3 "Recollection" point(s) and deploys a Zone that lasts for 2 turns. The Zone's duration decreases by 1 at the start of Cyrene's every turn. While the Zone lasts, for each instance of DMG dealt by all ally targets, deals 1 additional instance of True DMG equal to {true_dmg} of the original DMG. When Cyrene is downed, the Zone will also be dispelled.

kit.name: Verse ◦ Vow ∞
kit.description:
Summons memosprite Demiurge, causes it to immediately gain 1 extra turn, and activates all teammates' Ultimate. Then, enters the "Ripples of Past Reverie" state. Enhances Basic ATK to "To Love and Tomorrow ♪" and can only use this Basic ATK. Increases Cyrene's and Demiurge's CRIT Rate by {crit_rate}, and deploys the Zone effect from Skill with no duration limit.
Can only be used once per battle. Demiurge's initial Max HP equals to 100% of Cyrene's Max HP.

kit.name: Reunion at First Sight
kit.description: Enables Demiurge to immediately gain 1 extra turn.

kit.name: Hearts Gather as One
kit.description: When combat begins or after Cyrene takes action, other ally characters under any state and their memosprites gain "Future." When ally targets with "Future" take action, consumes "Future" to grant Cyrene 1 "Recollection" point(s). When Cyrene has 24 "Recollection" points, can activate Ultimate and dispel all debuffs on her. When she has 12 "Recollection" points during the "Ripples of Past Reverie" state, can activate Ultimate. After reaching the maximum, it can overflow by up to 27 points. While Cyrene is on the field, increases DMG dealt by all ally targets by {field_increases_dmg}.

kit.name: Peace at West Wind's End
kit.description: After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension that lasts for 30 second(s) around the character. Enemies within this Special Dimension enter the "This Moment, Forever" state. While in this state, enemies will cease all actions. Ally characters within this Special Dimension have 50% increased movement speed. After entering combat within the duration, deploys the Skill's Zone. Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

kit.name: Minuet of Blooms and Plumes
kit.description: Deals Ice DMG to all enemies equal to {ice_dmg} of Demiurge's Max HP.

kit.name: Ode to Earth
kit.description: When Demiurge uses Memosprite Skill, grants "Ode to Earth" to Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae, and enables the next 3 attack(s) of "Souldragon" to deal Additional DMG of the Bondmate's Type, equal to {type} of the Bondmate's Shield Effect. When Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae holds "Ode to Earth," the "Bondmate" deals {dmg} increased DMG. When used on Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae, advances Souldragon's action by 100%. Souldragon's next action gains the enhancement effect of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Ultimate and the Shield Effect provided by Souldragon is 150.0% of its original Shield Effect. Does not consume the enhancement number of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Ultimate.

kit.name: Ode to Ego
kit.description: For every 1 different teammate (i.e., excluding Demiurge) from whom Cyrene has gained "Recollection," additionally deals 1 instance of Ice DMG equal to {ice_dmg} of Demiurge's Max HP to one random enemy when Demiurge uses "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes." After Cyrene uses Ultimate or when Demiurge is summoned, Demiurge immediately gains 1 "Story." When "Story" reaches 3, Demiurge consumes all "Story" points to immediately gain 1 extra turn and automatically use "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes."

kit.name: Ode to Genesis
kit.description: Effective for the entire battle. When used on Trailblazer (Remembrance), increases Trailblazer (Remembrance)'s ATK by an amount equal to {remembrance_s_atk} of Demiurge's Max HP, and increases Trailblazer (Remembrance)'s CRIT Rate by an amount equal to {crit_rate} of Demiurge's CRIT Rate. This effect also applies to Mem. After Trailblazer (Remembrance) uses Enhanced Basic ATK in this battle, Demiurge immediately gains 1 extra turn and automatically uses "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes." If the target was defeated before this ability is used, it will be used on newly appeared enemy targets instead.

kit.name: Ode to Law
kit.description: Effective for the entire battle. After using on Cerydra, increases the CRIT DMG of the character with "Military Merit" by {military_merit}. After Coup de Main ends, Cerydra immediately gains 1 Charge.

kit.name: Ode to Life and Death
kit.description: Effective for the entire battle. When used on Castorice, "Newbud" can overflow up to 200%. When summoning Netherwing, consumes all overflowing "Newbud." For every 1% overflow amount consumed, increases the multiplier by {overflowing_newbud} for the DMG dealt when this summoned Netherwing triggers the ability effect of its Talent "Wings Sweep the Ruins." If there are 2 enemy target(s) or fewer on the field when summoned, the DMG multiplier additionally increases by {dmg_multiplier_additionally}.

kit.name: Ode to Ocean
kit.description: One-time effect. When used on Hysilens, Hysilens gains "Flowing Warmth." After Hysilens uses an attack, consumes "Flowing Warmth" and regenerates 60 Energy for this unit. In this battle, increases the DMG dealt by Hysilens by {hysilens}. After Hysilens uses Basic ATK/Skill to attack enemies, causes all the DoT currently applied on the attacked enemy targets to immediately produce DMG equal to {immediately_produce_dmg}/{3} of the original DMG.

kit.name: Ode to Passage
kit.description: Effective for the entire battle. When used on Tribbie, causes DMG dealt by Tribbie to ignore {tribbie_to_ignore} of enemies' DEF. When Tribbie launches Follow-Up ATK and triggers the Additional DMG from Tribbie's Zone, it further deals 1 instance(s) of Additional DMG.

kit.name: Ode to Reason
kit.description: One-time effect. When used on Anaxa, recovers 1 Skill Point(s) for allies and enables Anaxa to take action immediately. Skill has 3 more instances of DMG, lasting for 1 turn. The next time Anaxa uses Basic ATK or Skill, he gains "True Knowledge": All Erudition characters have their ATK increased by {skill_dmg} and their dealt Skill DMG increased by {2}, lasting until the start of Anaxa's next turn.

kit.name: Ode to Romance
kit.description: One-time effect. When used on Aglaea, causes Aglaea to gain "Romance" and immediately stacks Garmentmaker's Memosprite Talent's SPD Boost effect to its upper limit. After Aglaea or Garmentmaker uses an attack, consumes "Romance" and regenerates 70 Energy. Increases DMG dealt by Aglaea and Garmentmaker by {aglaea_and_garmentmaker}, and ignores {2} of the targets' DEF, lasting until Aglaea exits the "Supreme Stance" state.

kit.name: Ode to Sky
kit.description: When Demiurge uses Memosprite Skill, causes Hyacine to gain 2 stacks of "Ode to Sky." When used on Hyacine, regenerates {energy} Energy for Hyacine. When Hyacine has "Ode to Sky" and is providing healing, additionally increases the amount to be included in the tally of Little Ica's Memosprite Skill by an amount equal to {memosprite_skill} of the current healing amount. After Hyacine uses Skill/Ultimate, consumes 1 stack of "Ode to Sky."

kit.name: Ode to Strife
kit.description: One-time effect. When used on Mydei, removes all Crowd Control debuffs inflicted on him. And if Mydei is in the "Vendetta" state, he automatically uses 1 instance of "Godslayer Be God" without consuming Charge. Mydei's CRIT DMG increases by {during} during this attack. If the target gets defeated before the use, then it will target the newly arriving enemy targets instead. If Mydei is not in the "Vendetta" state, then advances Mydei's action by 100%.

kit.name: Ode to Time
kit.description: Effective for the entire battle. After it is used on Evernight, increases the DMG dealt when Evey uses the Memosprite Skill "Dream, Dissolving, as Dew" by {dissolving_as_dew}. After Evernight uses Skill/Ultimate, additionally gains 1 "Memoria." The CRIT DMG boost effect provided by the Skill is further increased by an amount equal to {skill} of Evernight's CRIT DMG.

kit.name: Ode to Trickery
kit.description: Effective for the entire battle. When used on Cipher, increases the DMG dealt by Cipher by {cipher}, decreases the DEF of the "Patron" by {patron} and decreases the DEF of all other enemy targets by {decreases_the_def}.

kit.name: Ode to Worldbearing
kit.description: Effective for the entire battle. After it is used on Phainon, Phainon gains 6 "Coreflame" as well as "Eternal Ignition" when Transforming. When Transforming, if "Coreflame" exceeds 12, for each point in excess, Khaslana's CRIT DMG increases by {crit_dmg}, up to a max increase of {2}. While "Eternal Ignition" persists, increases Khaslana's CRIT Rate by {crit_rate}. After the extra turns are depleted, the Transformation does not end, and all of Khaslana's extra turns get refreshed and 4 "Scourge" is granted. At the start of extra turns, Khaslana consumes HP equal to 15.0% of his current HP. After using an attack, deals 5 instances of Additional DMG, with each instance dealing Fire Additional DMG equal to {fire_additional_dmg} of Khaslana's ATK to one random enemy.

kit.name: This Ode, to All Lives
kit.description: Applies a buff to one designated ally character. When the character is a Chrysos Heir, the target gains a special effect. When the character is not a Chrysos Heir, increases the target's DMG dealt by {turns} for 2 turns. This effect also applies on memosprites.

kit.name: Waiting, In Every Past
kit.description: Demiurge's SPD remains at 0, and it will not appear on the Action Order. While on the field, it is considered as Out-of-Bounds. When Cyrene's HP percentage changes, Demiurge's HP percentage will also change accordingly. While Demiurge is on the field, Cyrene's and Demiurge's Max HP increases by {max_hp}. After Demiurge uses abilities, decreases the duration of all Continuous Effects on this unit by 1.

kit.name: "Hello, World ♪"
kit.description: When Demiurge is summoned, dispels Crowd Control debuffs from all allies.

kit.name: Causality in Trichotomy
kit.description: When Cyrene's SPD is 180 or higher, increases all allies' DMG dealt by 20%. Then, for every 1 SPD that exceeds 180, increases Cyrene's and Demiurge's Ice RES PEN by 2%. Up to a maximum of 60 excess SPD can be taken into account for this effect.

kit.name: Child of Remembrance
kit.description: When a teammate's memosprite is summoned, it gains "Future." "Future" held by the memosprite won't be consumed.

kit.name: Ripples Across Time
kit.description: When there are 1/2/3 Chrysos Heir or Remembrance characters (excluding Cyrene) in the team, Cyrene gains 2/3/6 "Recollection" point(s) respectively at the start of combat.

kit.name: Epics, Born on a Blank Slate
kit.description: When Demiurge triggers the Memosprite Skill "Ode to Ego" during the use of "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes," gains 6 "Recollection" point(s) and increases the number of bounces for this attack by 12.

kit.name: A Tomorrow in Thirteen Shades
kit.description: When entering combat, additionally gains 12 "Recollection" point(s). For every 1 different ally character that gains the Memosprite Skill buff from Demiurge, the DMG multiplier for the True DMG dealt by ally targets via the Skill's Zone increases by 6%, up to a max increase of 24%.

kit.name: By Thy Being, As I've Written
kit.description:

Consumes HP by an amount equal to 35% of Mydei's current HP. Deals Imaginary DMG equal to {imaginary_dmg} of Mydei's Max HP to one enemy and Imaginary DMG equal to {2} of Mydei's Max HP to adjacent targets.
If the current HP is not sufficient, using Skill reduces Mydei's current HP to 1.
This ability will be automatically used.

kit.name: Throne of Bones
kit.description: Restores HP by {hp} of Mydei's Max HP and accumulates 20 Talent's Charge point(s). Deals Imaginary DMG equal to {imaginary_dmg} of Mydei's Max HP to one designated enemy, and deals Imaginary DMG equal to {3} of Mydei's Max HP to adjacent targets. Additionally, Taunts the target and targets adjacent to it, lasting for 2 turn(s). The next use of "Godslayer Be God" prioritizes attacking one designated enemy, and this effect only works on the latest target.

kit.name: Blood for Blood
kit.description:
For each 1% of HP lost, accumulates 1 point of Charge (up to 200 points). When Charge reaches 100, consumes 100 points of Charge to enter the "Vendetta" state, restores HP equal to {state_restores_hp} of Mydei's Max HP, and advances action by 100%. While the "Vendetta" state is active, Max HP increases by 50% of the current Max HP and DEF remains at 0. At the start of this unit's turn, automatically uses "Kingslayer Be King."
When Charge reaches 150 points during the "Vendetta" state, Mydei immediately gains 1 extra turn and automatically uses "Godslayer Be God."
When receiving a killing blow during the "Vendetta" state, Mydei will not be knocked down, but will clear his Charge, exits the "Vendetta" state, and restores HP by 50% of his Max HP.

kit.name: Cage of Broken Lance
kit.description:
After using Technique, pulls in enemies within a certain area and inflicts Daze on them for 10 second(s). Dazed enemies will not actively attack ally targets.
If actively attacking Dazed enemies, when entering battle, deals Imaginary DMG equal to 80% of Mydei's Max HP to all enemies, and Taunts the targets, lasting for 1 turn(s). This unit accumulates 50 point(s) of Talent's Charge.

kit.name: Bloodied Chiton
kit.description: When battle starts, if Mydei's Max HP exceeds 4000, for every 100 excess HP, Mydei's CRIT Rate increases by 1.2%, his Charge ratio from enemy targets' DMG increases by 2.5%, and his Incoming Healing increases by 0.75%. Up to 4000 excess HP can be taken into account for this effect.

kit.name: Earth and Water
kit.description: During the "Vendetta" state, Mydei will not exit the "Vendetta" state when receiving a killing blow. This effect can trigger 3 time(s) per battle.

kit.name: Thirty Tyrants
kit.description: While in the "Vendetta" state, Mydei is immune to Crowd Control debuffs.

kit.name: Frost Hones Spine of Steel
kit.description: Increases the DMG multiplier dealt by "Godslayer Be God" to the primary target by 30%. This ability now deals to all enemies Imaginary DMG equal to the DMG multiplier dealt to the primary target.

kit.name: Strife Beholds Cry of Dead
kit.description: During "Vendetta," the DMG dealt by Mydei ignores 15% of enemy targets' DEF. After he receives healing, converts 40% of the healed amount to Charge. The tally of the converted Charge cannot exceed 40 point(s). Resets this tally of Charge after any unit takes action.

kit.name: Honor Exalts Feast of Faith
kit.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

kit.name: Siren Jolts the Laconic Lion
kit.description: While in "Vendetta," increases CRIT DMG by 30% and restores HP by 10% of this unit's Max HP after receiving attacks from enemy targets.

kit.name: War Chisels Flesh of Flame
kit.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

kit.name: Legacy Scales Mound of Blood
kit.description: When entering battle, immediately enters the "Vendetta" state, and lowers the Charge required for "Godslayer Be God" to 100 point(s).

kit.name: Behind the Kindness
kit.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to {physical_dmg} of Natasha's ATK to a single enemy.

kit.name: Love, Heal, and Choose
kit.description: Restores a single ally for {max_hp} of Natasha's Max HP plus {2} Restores the ally for another {3} of Natasha's Max HP plus {4} at the beginning of each turn for 2 turn(s).

kit.name: Gift of Rebirth
kit.description: Heals all allies for {all_allies} of Natasha's Max HP plus {max_hp}

kit.name: Innervation
kit.description: When healing allies with HP percentage at 30% or lower, increases Natasha's Outgoing Healing by {outgoing_healing}. This effect also works on continuous healing.

kit.name: Hypnosis Research
kit.description:
Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals Physical DMG equal to 80% of Natasha's ATK to a random enemy, with a 100% base chance to Weaken all enemies.
While Weakened, enemies deal 30% less DMG to allies for 1 turn(s).

kit.name: Healer
kit.description: Natasha's Outgoing Healing increases by 10%.

kit.name: Recuperation
kit.description: Increases the duration of Skill's continuous healing effect for 1 turn(s).

kit.name: Soothe
kit.description: When using Skill, dispels 1 debuff(s) from one designated ally.

kit.name: Pharmacology Expertise
kit.description: After being attacked, if the current HP percentage is 30% or lower, heals self for 1 time to restore HP by an amount equal to 15% of Max HP plus 400. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per battle.

kit.name: Clinical Research
kit.description: When Natasha uses her Ultimate, grant continuous healing for 1 turn(s) to allies whose HP percentage is at 30% or lower. And at the beginning of their turn, their HP is restored by an amount equal to 6% of Natasha's Max HP plus 160.

kit.name: The Right Cure
kit.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

kit.name: Miracle Cure
kit.description: After being attacked, regenerates 5 extra Energy.

kit.name: Preventive Treatment
kit.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

kit.name: Doctor's Grace
kit.description: Natasha's Basic ATK additionally deals Physical DMG equal to 40% of her Max HP.

kit.name: Frost Shot
kit.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to {ice_dmg} of Pela's ATK to a single target enemy.

kit.name: Frostbite
kit.description: Removes 1 buff(s) and deals Ice DMG equal to {ice_dmg} of Pela's ATK to one designated target enemy.

kit.name: Zone Suppression
kit.description:
Deals Ice DMG equal to {ice_dmg} of Pela's ATK to all enemies, with a 100% base chance to inflict Exposed on all enemies.
When Exposed, enemies' DEF is reduced by {def_is_reduced} for 2 turn(s).

kit.name: Data Collecting
kit.description: If the enemy is debuffed after Pela's attack, Pela will restore {energy} additional Energy. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per attack.

kit.name: Preemptive Strike
kit.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. Upon entering battle, Pela deals Ice DMG equal to 80% of her ATK to a random enemy, with a 100% base chance of lowering the DEF of all enemies by 20% for 2 turn(s).

kit.name: Bash
kit.description: Deals 20% more DMG to debuffed enemy targets.

kit.name: The Secret Strategy
kit.description: When Pela is on the battlefield, all allies' Effect Hit Rate increases by 10%.

kit.name: Wipe Out
kit.description: When using Skill to dispel buff(s), increases the DMG dealt by the next attack by 20%.

kit.name: Victory Report
kit.description: When an enemy is defeated, Pela regenerates 5 Energy.

kit.name: Adamant Charge
kit.description: Using Skill to dispel buff(s) increases SPD by 10% for 2 turn(s).

kit.description: When using Skill, there is a 100% base chance to reduce the target enemy's Ice RES by 12% for 2 turn(s).

Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

kit.description: After Pela attacks, if the enemy target is debuffed, deals Ice Additional DMG equal to 40% of Pela's ATK to the enemy.

kit.name: Stride to Deliverance
kit.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to {physical_dmg} of Phainon's ATK to one designated enemy.

kit.name: Creation: Bloodthorn Ferry
kit.description: Gains 2 point(s) of "Scourge", dealing Physical DMG equal to {physical_dmg} of Khaslana's ATK to one designated enemy and Physical DMG equal to {2} of Khaslana's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.

kit.name: Calamity: Soulscorch Edict
kit.description:
Gains "Scourge" by an amount equal to the number of enemies and 1 stack of "Soulscorch," then causes all enemies to immediately take action.
While in the "Soulscorch" state, Khaslana takes 75.0% reduced DMG. After an enemy target attacks or takes action, gains 1 more stack of "Soulscorch." After said enemy targets finish their actions, immediately launches Counter, deals Physical DMG to all enemies equal to {physical_dmg} of Khaslana's ATK, and additionally deals 4 instance(s) of DMG, with each instance being Physical DMG equal to {being_physical_dmg} of Khaslana's ATK. Afterward, "Soulscorch" is dispelled. Each "Soulscorch" stack increases the DMG multiplier of said Counter by 20.0% of its original multiplier value.
DMG dealt through this ability is considered as Skill DMG. If "Soulscorch" is still active at the start of Khaslana's extra turn, immediately launches Counter.

kit.name: Foundation: Stardeath Verdict
kit.description:
Dispels all debuffs on this unit, then deals Physical DMG equal to a max of {physical_dmg} of Khaslana's ATK.
For every 1 point of "Scourge" consumed, deals 4 instance(s) of DMG, with each instance being Physical DMG equal to {being_physical_dmg} of Khaslana's ATK dealt to one random enemy. When consuming 4 point(s) of "Scourge", additionally deals Physical DMG equal to {3} of Khaslana's ATK, which is evenly distributed across all enemies.

kit.name: Let There Be Light
kit.description: Gains 2 point(s) of "Coreflame," dealing Physical DMG equal to {physical_dmg} of Phainon's ATK to one designated enemy and Physical DMG equal to {2} of Phainon's ATK to adjacent targets.

kit.name: He Who Bears the World Must Burn
kit.description:
Transforms into Khaslana. During the transformation, deploys the Territory "Ruinous Irontomb." Within the Territory, other teammates depart and cannot take action, and all enemies have Physical Weakness.
Khaslana does not enter his own turn, but has 8 Khaslana's extra turn(s) with a SPD set at 60.0% of Khaslana's base SPD. When the last of Khaslana's extra turns starts, immediately launches a final hit and deals Physical Ultimate DMG equal to {physical_ultimate_dmg} of Khaslana's ATK that is distributed evenly across all enemies.

kit.name: Fate: Divine Vessel
kit.description:
Khaslana's Talent. Upon transformation, gains 4 point(s) of "Scourge". If this happens during an ally target's turn, then the duration of all buffs on that target is extended by 1 turn and the current turn ends.
Khaslana is immune to Crowd Control debuffs, has 1 Enhanced Basic ATK and 2 Enhanced Skills, but cannot use Ultimate. During the transformation, increases ATK by {transformation_increases_atk} and Max HP by {max_hp}. After using an attack, restores HP equal to 20% of his Max HP. When Khaslana takes a killing blow, he will not get knocked down. Instead, he will restore HP equal to 25% of Max HP and immediately launch a final hit. For every 1 remaining Khaslana's extra turn, the final hit's DMG multiplier decreases by 12.5% of its original multiplier value.
When the transformation ends, increases all allies' SPD by 15% for 1 turn.

kit.name: Pyric Corpus
kit.description:
Phainon's Talent. When "Coreflame" reaches 12 point(s), can activate Ultimate. Even after reaching the max limit, can still hold up to 3 overflow point(s). When the transformation ends, gains "Coreflames" based on the number of overflow points.
When Phainon is targeted by an ability from any other target, gains 1 "Coreflame" point. And if the ability is cast by one of Phainon's teammates, can also increase Phainon's CRIT DMG by {crit_dmg} for 3 turn(s).

kit.name: Beginning of the End
kit.description:
While Phainon is in the team, increases Max Technique Points by 3.
When actively using this Technique, consumes 2 Technique Points and immediately attacks all enemies within a certain range. After entering battle, regenerates 25 Energy for allies and gains 2 "Scourge" and 1 Skill Point(s). Deals Physical DMG equal to 200% of Phainon's ATK to all enemies at the start of each wave.
If attacking a normal enemy, immediately defeats them without entering combat. No Technique Points are consumed if no enemies are hit.

kit.name: Bide in Flames
kit.description:
When receiving healing or a Shield from a teammate, deals 45% increased DMG for 4 turn(s). This effect cannot be triggered repeatedly within one turn.
When receiving an Energy Regeneration effect from a teammate's ability, gains 1 point(s) of "Coreflame."

kit.name: March to Oblivion
kit.description: When the battle starts, gains 1 point(s) of "Coreflame." When the transformation ends, gains 3 point(s) of "Coreflame."

kit.name: Shine with Valor
kit.description: When entering combat or ending transformation, increases ATK by 50%. This effect can stack up to 2 time(s).

kit.name: Fire and Light Bind Virtue and Vice
kit.description:
The base SPD inheritance ratio for Khaslana's extra turn increases to 66%. For every enemy target defeated in one battle, additionally increases this ratio by 1.5%, up to a max of 84%.
When using Ultimate, increases CRIT DMG by 50%, lasting for 3 turn(s).

kit.name: Sky and Earth Churn Mortal Froth
kit.description: Khaslana's Physical RES PEN increases by 20%. When one use of "Foundation: Stardeath Verdict" consumes 4 "Scourge" point(s), gains 1 extra turn.

kit.name: Depths of Quiet, Entombed in Ruin
kit.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

kit.name: Faces of Titans, Blurred by Time
kit.description: When using "Calamity: Soulscorch Edict," additionally gains 4 stack(s) of "Soulscorch."

kit.name: The Wheel Spins Forevermore
kit.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

kit.name: Embers of Old Rise Still
kit.description:
The number of Overflow point for "Coreflame" no longer has an upper limit. When battle starts, gains 6 "Coreflame(s)."
After using "Foundation: Stardeath Verdict's" attack, additionally deals True DMG equal to 36% of the total DMG dealt in this attack to the enemy with the highest HP.

kit.name: Flower Pick
kit.description: Tosses 1 jade tile from the suit with the fewest tiles in hand to deal Quantum DMG equal to {quantum_dmg} of Qingque's ATK to a single enemy.

kit.name: Cherry on Top!
kit.description:
Deals Quantum DMG equal to {quantum_dmg} of Qingque's ATK to a single enemy, and deals Quantum DMG equal to {2} of Qingque's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.
"Cherry on Top!" cannot recover Skill Points.

kit.name: A Scoop of Moon
kit.description: Immediately draws 2 jade tile(s) and increases DMG by {dmg} until the end of the current turn. This effect can stack up to 4 time(s). The turn will not end after this Skill is used.

kit.name: A Quartet? Woo-hoo!
kit.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to {quantum_dmg} of Qingque's ATK to all enemies, and obtains 4 jade tiles of the same suit.

kit.name: Celestial Jade
kit.description:
When an ally's turn starts, Qingque randomly draws 1 tile from 3 different suits and can hold up to 4 tiles at one time.
If Qingque starts her turn with 4 tiles of the same suit, she consumes all tiles to enter the "Hidden Hand" state.
While in this state, Qingque cannot use her Skill again. At the same time, Qingque's ATK increases by {time_qingque_s_atk}, and her Basic ATK "Flower Pick" is enhanced, becoming "Cherry on Top!" The "Hidden Hand" state ends after using "Cherry on Top!".

kit.name: Game Solitaire
kit.description: After using Technique, Qingque draws 2 jade tile(s) when the battle starts.

kit.name: Bide Time
kit.description: Using the Skill increases DMG Boost effect of attacks by an extra 10%.

kit.name: Tile Battle
kit.description: Restores 1 Skill Point when using the Skill. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per battle.

kit.name: Winning Hand
kit.description: Qingque's SPD increases by 10% for 1 turn after using the Enhanced Basic ATK.

kit.name: Rise Through the Tiles
kit.description: Ultimate deals 10% more DMG.

kit.name: Sleep on the Tiles
kit.description: Every time Draw Tile is triggered, Qingque immediately regenerates 1 Energy.

kit.name: Read Between the Tiles
kit.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

kit.name: Right on the Tiles
kit.description:
After using Skill, there is a 24% fixed chance to gain "Self-Sufficer," lasting until the end of the current turn. 
While "Self-Sufficer" is active, using Basic ATK or Enhanced Basic ATK immediately launches 1 Follow-up ATK on the same target, dealing Quantum DMG equal to 100% of Basic ATK DMG or Enhanced Basic ATK DMG.

kit.name: Gambit for the Tiles
kit.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

kit.name: Ninjutsu: Rise Above Tumbles
kit.description: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to {imaginary_dmg} of Rappa's ATK to one designated enemy.

kit.name: Ningu: Demonbane Petalblade
kit.description:
Launches "Ningu: Demonbane Petalblade." The first 2 hits deal Imaginary DMG equal to {imaginary_dmg} of Rappa's ATK to one designated enemy and Imaginary DMG equal to {2} of Rappa's ATK to adjacent targets, and the 3rd hit deals Imaginary DMG equal to {3} of Rappa's ATK to all enemies.
Enhanced Basic ATK will not recover Skill Points. Attacking enemies that don't have Imaginary Weakness can also reduce Toughness, whose effect is equal to 50% of the original Toughness Reduction. When Breaking Weakness, triggers the Imaginary Weakness Break effect.

kit.name: Ninja Strike: Rooted Resolute
kit.description: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to {imaginary_dmg} of Rappa's ATK to all enemies.

kit.name: Nindō Supreme: Aishiteru
kit.description:
Enters the "Sealform" state, immediately gains 1 extra turn, obtains 3 points of "Chroma Ink," and increases Weakness Break Efficiency by 50% and Break Effect by {break_effect}.
While in the "Sealform" state, Basic ATK is enhanced, and Skill and Ultimate cannot be used. After using Enhanced Basic ATK, consumes 1 point of "Chroma Ink." When "Chroma Ink" is depleted, exits the "Sealform" state.

kit.name: Ninja Tech: Endurance Gauge
kit.description:
Each time the enemy target is Weakness Broken, Rappa gains 1 point of Charge, up to a max of 10 points of Charge. When Rappa next launches the third hit of "Ningu: Demonbane Petalblade," additionally deals Break DMG equal to {break_dmg} of Rappa's Imaginary Break DMG to all enemies. This DMG can ignore Weakness Type to reduce 2 Toughness, consuming all Charge. Each point of Charge increases the Break DMG multiplier by {break_dmg_multiplier} and increases the Toughness Reduction that can ignore Weakness Type by 1.
When Breaking Weakness, triggers the Imaginary Weakness Break effect.

kit.name: Ninja Dash: By Leaps and Bounds
kit.description: After using Technique, enters the "Graffiti" state for 20 seconds. While in the "Graffiti" state, moves forward rapidly for a set distance and attacks any enemies touched. During the rapid movement, can block all enemies' attacks. Using an attack in the "Graffiti" state can end the state's duration early. After entering combat via attacking enemies, deals 30 Toughness Reduction regardless of Weakness Type and Break DMG equal to 200% of Rappa's Imaginary Break DMG to each enemy target, and deals Break DMG equal to 180% of Rappa's Imaginary Break DMG to adjacent targets. At the same time, this unit regenerates 10 Energy.

kit.name: Ninjutsu Inscription: Sea Echo
kit.description: While in the "Sealform" state, after Rappa uses Enhanced Basic ATK to deal DMG to a Weakness Broken enemy target, converts the Toughness Reduction from this instance of DMG to 1 instance of 60% Super Break DMG.

kit.name: Ninjutsu Inscription: Sky High
kit.description: When the Weakness of an elite-level or higher enemy is broken, Rappa additionally gains 1 point(s) of Charge and regenerates 10 Energy.

kit.name: Ninjutsu Inscription: Withered Leaf
kit.description: When an enemy target becomes Weakness Broken, increases the Break DMG taken by 2%. If Rappa's current ATK is higher than 2,400, for every 100 excess ATK, additionally increases this value by 1%, up to a max additional increase of 8%. This effect lasts for 2 turn(s).

kit.name: Returned Is the Revenant With No Ferry Toll
kit.description: During the "Sealform" state entered by using Ultimate, DMG dealt by Rappa ignores 15% of the targets' DEF. After exiting the "Sealform" state, regenerates 20 Energy.

kit.name: Free Is the Mind Enlightened by Haikus
kit.description: The Enhanced Basic ATK's first 2 hits have their Toughness Reduction against the one designated enemy increased by 50%.

Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

kit.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

kit.name: Righteous Is the Wrath That Spares No Evil
kit.description: When battle starts, Rappa gains 5 point(s) of her Talent's Charge, and its upper limit increases by 5 point(s). After launching the third hit of "Ningu: Demonbane Petalblade," gains 5 point(s) of Charge.

kit.name: Bajiquan
kit.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to {quantum_dmg} of Rin Tohsaka's ATK to one designated enemy.

kit.name: Jeweled Sword Zelretch
kit.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to {quantum_dmg} of Rin Tohsaka's ATK to one designated enemy.

kit.name: Second Magic Experiment
kit.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to {quantum_dmg} of Rin Tohsaka's ATK to all enemies. Then, consumes 3 "Gem Energy" to additionally deal Quantum DMG equal to {2} of Rin Tohsaka's ATK to one random enemy target. This repeats until "Gem Energy" is less than 3 or there are no enemy targets with current HP greater than 0. Can repeat up to 33 cycle(s). When used, if the current Skill Points are greater than 2, consumes Skill Points down to 2, and for each Point consumed, immediately gains 2 "Gem Energy."

kit.name: An Gal Ta Ki Gal Šè
kit.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to {quantum_dmg} of Rin Tohsaka's ATK to one designated enemy, and Quantum DMG equal to {2} of Rin Tohsaka's ATK to other enemy targets. When used, recovers 1 Skill Point(s) for allies, and increases the DMG taken by all enemies by {dmg}, lasting for 3 turn(s).

kit.name: Gem Magecraft
kit.description: When entering combat, gains 20 "Gem Energy." When an ally target consumes or recovers Skill Points, increases their CRIT DMG by {crit_dmg} for 2 turn(s). For every 1 Skill Point consumed or recovered, Rin Tohsaka gains 1 "Gem Energy." If Rin Tohsaka holds 15 or more "Gem Energy," or if the current Skill Points are 7 or more, her Skill is enhanced to "Second Magic Experiment."

kit.name: Freeform Tohsaka Style
kit.description: After Archer uses his Skill "Caladbolg II: Fake Spiral Sword" to attack, if Skill Points are 3 or fewer or if "Caladbolg II: Fake Spiral Sword" has been actively used 5 times during the current "Circuit Connection" state, and the Joint Follow-Up ATK from "Freeform Tohsaka Style" has not been triggered, Rin Tohsaka and Archer will launch Joint Follow-Up ATK on all enemies, dealing Quantum DMG equal to {quantum_dmg} of Rin Tohsaka's ATK and {rin_tohsaka_s_atk} of Archer's ATK respectively, and recovering 4 Skill Point(s) for allies. This Joint Follow-Up ATK can only trigger once. The trigger count resets when Rin Tohsaka's turn ends.

kit.name: Conversion Charge
kit.description: After using Technique, gains 10 "Gem Energy" at the start of the next battle.

kit.name: Elegant Conduct
kit.description: While Rin Tohsaka is on the field, additionally increases the upper limit of Skill Points by 2. When entering combat, Rin Tohsaka's ATK increases by 150%, and Quantum RES PEN increases by 15%. If Archer is in the team, Archer also gains this effect.

kit.name: Inbound Prosperity
kit.description: When Rin Tohsaka uses Ultimate, gains 12 "Gem Energy."

kit.name: Ladylike Poise
kit.description: When entering combat or after using Enhanced Skill, increases Rin Tohsaka's SPD by 20%, lasting for 3 turn(s).

kit.name: Zelretch's Apprentice
kit.description:
If one instance of the Enhanced Skill consumes 30 or more "Gem Energy," Rin Tohsaka gains "Shadow Gem" equal to the amount of "Gem Energy" consumed.
While holding "Shadow Gem," enhances Skill to "Second Magic Experiment." The Enhanced Skill consumes all "Shadow Gem," does not trigger the effect that converts Skill Points into "Gem Energy," and does not consume "Gem Energy."

kit.name: Dimensional Traveler
kit.description: Rin Tohsaka's Skill DMG dealt increases by 30%. While Rin Tohsaka is on the field, Skill DMG dealt by all allies becomes 130% of the original DMG.

kit.name: Holy Grail War: Victory Memorial
kit.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

kit.name: Red Devil: Triple Speed
kit.description: When the CRIT DMG boost effect from the Talent "Gem Magecraft" applies to Rin Tohsaka, the effect can stack, up to 2 time(s).

kit.name: Goddess of Venus's Favor
kit.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

kit.name: Nailed It This Time!
kit.description: Rin Tohsaka's All-Type RES PEN increases by 20%. When using Ultimate, gains 24 "Gem Energy" and 1 extra turn.

kit.name: Wingflip White Noise
kit.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to {physical_dmg} of Robin's ATK to a single target enemy.

kit.name: Pinion's Aria
kit.description: Increase DMG dealt by all allies by {dmg}, lasting for 3 turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of Robin's every turn.

kit.name: Vox Harmonique, Opus Cosmique
kit.description:
Robin enters the Concerto state and makes all teammates (i.e., excluding this unit) immediately take action.
While in the Concerto state, increases all allies' ATK by {all_allies_atk} of Robin's ATK plus {atk} Moreover, after every attack by ally targets, Robin deals Physical Additional DMG equal to {physical_additional_dmg} of her ATK for 1 time, with a fixed CRIT Rate for this damage set at 100% and fixed CRIT DMG set at 150%.
While in the Concerto state, Robin is immune to Crowd Control debuffs and cannot enter her turn or take action until the Concerto state ends.
